To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a novel method for preparing a series of metal-naphthalene compounds, which have been shown to have a molecular structure.
we have demonstrated that a novel, non-viral, synthetic, and biodegradable nanomaterial (termed “nanocage”) has the potential to be used for the targeted delivery of therapeutic molecules.
the method of preparation of the metal naphthaline mixtures is a simple, rapid and reproducible procedure for producing metal powders with a very fine distribution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new method of preparation of molecular mixtures.
the development of a new class of materials that are based on the combination of a molecularly imprinted polymer (MIP) with a magnetic nanoparticle (MNP).

the synthesis and characterization of a series of new compounds, the so-called “molecular mixtures” or “molecular compounds” of metals and hydrocarbons, which are obtained by the action of metals in the vapour state on the liquid hydrocarbon at a temperature of 300-500° C.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the method described here is capable of yielding molecular compounds of metals in naphthalene.

a new method of preparation was used which produced an amorphous metal powder, which was embedded in naphthalene, in such a manner that the powder gave no x-ray interference pattern and the naphthalene also did not give any x-ray interference pattern, whereas the x-ray interference pattern obtained after the removal of the naphthaline was very weak.

the present study has demonstrated that the combination of a high dose of 1,25(OH)2D3 (100 ng/kg) and a low dose of PTH (0.5 μg/kg) results in the greatest increase in serum calcium, urinary calcium, and urinary hydroxyproline.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found a way of making molecular compounds of the metals.
we have found a way to produce a mixture of metal and hydrocarbon, which is so intimately mixed, that it shows no interference pattern when examined by X-rays.

the method described here makes it possible to produce molecular mixtures of metals and organic compounds, in which the metal is embedded in a matrix of the organic compound in such fine distribution that the metal does not give any X-ray diffraction pattern.

the presence of the ionic liquid is not a prerequisite for the formation of the metal nanoparticles.
the use of molecular dynamics simulations can help to elucidate the mechanisms underlying the formation of metal nanoparticles in solution and the effect of different ligands on these mechanisms.
